WITH active_charters AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, FundingType
  FROM schools
  WHERE Charter = 1
    AND StatusType = 'Active'
    AND FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
),
frpm_2014_15 AS (
  SELECT CDSCode,
         "Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
         "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_pct
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
),
sat_by_school AS (
  SELECT cds,
         AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS combined_sat
  FROM satscores
  WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cds
)
SELECT a.FundingType AS funding_category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.CDSCode) AS active_charter_schools,
       SUM(f.enrollment) AS total_2014_2015_k12_enrollment,
       ROUND(AVG(f.frpm_pct), 2) AS average_frpm_eligible_percent,
       ROUND(AVG(s.combined_sat), 2) AS average_combined_sat
FROM active_charters a
LEFT JOIN frpm_2014_15 f ON f.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN sat_by_school s ON s.cds = a.CDSCode
GROUP BY a.FundingType
ORDER BY a.FundingType

WITH funding_types(funding_type, sort_order) AS (
  VALUES ('Directly Funded', 1), ('Locally Funded', 2)
), latest_frpm_year AS (
  SELECT MAX("Academic Year") AS academic_year
  FROM frpm
), county_office_charters AS (
  SELECT f."CDSCode", f."Charter Funding Type" AS funding_type,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
         f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_k12, s."StatusType"
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN latest_frpm_year y ON f."Academic Year" = y.academic_year
  JOIN schools s ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
  WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
    AND f."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly Funded', 'Locally Funded')
    AND s."DOCType" = 'County Office of Education'
), aggregates AS (
  SELECT funding_type,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "StatusType" = 'Active' THEN "CDSCode" END) AS operating_schools,
         SUM(CASE WHEN "StatusType" = 'Active' THEN enrollment_k12 ELSE 0 END) AS enrollment_k12,
         SUM(CASE WHEN "StatusType" = 'Active' THEN frpm_k12 ELSE 0 END) AS frpm_k12
  FROM county_office_charters
  GROUP BY funding_type
)
SELECT ft.funding_type,
       COALESCE(a.operating_schools, 0) AS currently_operating_schools,
       COALESCE(a.enrollment_k12, 0) AS total_enrollment_k12,
       COALESCE(a.frpm_k12, 0) AS total_frpm_eligible_k12_students
FROM funding_types ft
LEFT JOIN aggregates a ON a.funding_type = ft.funding_type
ORDER BY ft.sort_order

WITH frpm_school AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    "County Name" AS county,
    "School Name" AS school_name,
    "Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    "FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count,
    "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" / 100.0 AS frpm_share
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "Academic Year" = (SELECT MAX("Academic Year") FROM frpm)
    AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
    AND "School Type" = 'Regular'
    AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 100
),
sat AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    CASE WHEN NumTstTakr > 0
      THEN AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite
    END AS avg_total_sat,
    CASE WHEN NumTstTakr > 0
      THEN NumGE1500 * 100.0 / NumTstTakr
    END AS pct_ge_1500
  FROM satscores
),
results AS (
  SELECT
    'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part,
    f.school_name,
    f.county,
    s.City AS city,
    s.MailStreet AS mail_street,
    s.MailCity AS mail_city,
    s.MailState AS mail_state,
    s.MailZip AS mail_zip,
    s.Website AS website,
    f.enrollment_k12,
    f.frpm_count,
    f.frpm_share,
    t.avg_total_sat,
    t.pct_ge_1500,
    s.OpenDate AS open_date,
    CASE WHEN s.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status,
    1 AS part_order
  FROM frpm_school f
  LEFT JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN sat t ON t.cds = f.CDSCode
  WHERE f.frpm_count = (SELECT MAX(frpm_count) FROM frpm_school)

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'smallest FRPM share',
    f.school_name,
    f.county,
    s.City,
    s.MailStreet,
    s.MailCity,
    s.MailState,
    s.MailZip,
    s.Website,

         SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
           WHEN t.account IS NOT NULL AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
           THEN t.bank || ':' || CAST(t.account AS TEXT)
         END) AS external_counterparties
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id

loan_totals AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
),

  FROM gold_accounts ga
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ga.account_id
  JOIN district ON district.district_id = a.district_id
  LEFT JOIN transaction_totals tt ON tt.account_id = ga.account_id

SELECT account_id,
       district_name,

WITH tabor AS (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
), eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN tabor d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE a.date <= '1996-12-31'
), owners AS (
    SELECT e.account_id, e.opened_date, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM eligible_accounts e
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = e.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
), activity AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count_1997,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in_1997,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYBER', 'VYDAJ') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out_1997,
           MAX(balance) AS peak_balance_1997
    FROM trans
    WHERE date >= '1997-01-01' AND date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY account_id
), loans AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_default,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status IN ('C','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_repaying
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
), cards AS (
    SELECT dp.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM card ca
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
    WHERE ca.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY dp.account_id
), profiled AS (
    SELECT o.account_id,
           o.opened_date,
           o.gender,
           CAST(strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', o.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
             - (strftime('%m-%d', '1996-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', o.birth_date)) AS age_years,
           COALESCE(c.card_count, 0) AS cards_held,
           COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0) AS loans_held,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan'
                WHEN l.has_default = 1 THEN 'defaulted'
                WHEN l.has_repaying = 1 THEN 'repaying'
                ELSE 'paid off' END AS loan_standing,
           COALESCE(a.transaction_count_1997, 0) AS transaction_count_1997,
           COALESCE(a.money_in_1997, 0) AS money_in_1997,
           COALESCE(a.money_out_1997, 0) AS money_out_1997,
           COALESCE(a.peak_balance_1997, 0) AS peak_balance_1997
    FROM owners o
    LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.account_id = o.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loans l ON l.account_id = o.account_id
    LEFT JOIN activity a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
)
SELECT account_id, opened_date, gender, age_years, cards_held, loans_held,
       loan_standing, transaction_count_1997, money_in_1997, money_out_1997,
       peak_balance_1997,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance_1997 DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM profiled
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id

WITH atom_counts AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_id,
    b.molecule_id,
    b.bond_type,
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS touches_carbon
  FROM bond AS b
  LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
  GROUP BY b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds,
    SUM(touches_carbon) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('double', 'triple', '=', '#', '2', '3') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
  FROM bond_endpoints
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
    ac.number_of_atoms,
    COALESCE(bc.number_of_bonds, 0) AS number_of_bonds,
    ac.carbon_atoms AS number_of_carbon_atoms,
    ac.chlorine_atoms AS number_of_chlorine_atoms,
    COALESCE(bc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS number_of_carbon_touching_bonds,
    COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS number_of_multiple_bonds,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY COALESCE(bc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC,
               ac.number_of_atoms DESC,
               m.molecule_id ASC
    ) AS rank_position
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN atom_counts AS ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts AS bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE ac.carbon_atoms > 0
)
SELECT
  rank_position,
  molecule_id,
  carcinogenicity_label,
  number_of_atoms,
  number_of_bonds,
  number_of_carbon_atoms,
  number_of_chlorine_atoms,
  number_of_carbon_touching_bonds,
  number_of_multiple_bonds
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank_position;
